objective: Implement the minimal end-to-end runtime/application coordinator for detach/reconnect, restart reconciliation, model-error hold/recheck, takeover state, explicit full shutdown, and reboot confirmation without automatic replay.
dependencies: CW-05 separated frontend/backend lifetime and src/workbench/runtime/g4.py ports
CW-06 three-area UI/direct OMP input contracts
CW-08 mailbox OMP session/unknown-state and no-replay boundary
CW-11 serialized review/check scheduling and last-check evidence

required_behavior: Detach releases only the frontend lease: both OMPs, backend, experiment process/PTY drain and raw observation remain alive; active automation checks may continue, paused automation schedules no new model check, and reconnect creates no duplicate run or command replay.

Backend/agent restart reconciles durable identity/session/owner/control/takeover/command-delivery/pause/cancel state against fresh process evidence. Unknown, drifted or unverifiable state is visible and cannot auto-replay or auto-start.

Model/auth/API error holds only model-dependent decisions, preserves experiment and raw observation, records last successful/failed check time, and requires an explicit successful recheck before automation resumes.

Takeover request, confirmation, current user owner, control mode and delivered-command state survive detach/reconnect. No command is transmitted until explicit current-session handoff confirmation; stale owner epoch/session requests never replay.

Explicit full shutdown is confirmation-gated, closes new admission, requests bounded normal stop before any allowed force path, drains observation, checks every managed target/descendant, preserves evidence, and reports unresolved survivors instead of claiming completion.

A boot marker change blocks new experiments until explicit user confirmation after reconciliation; no real host reboot is required for the fixture. Metadata durable failure blocks only new automatic runs and explicit durable success reopens; raw-log failure/cap never stops the run/drain.
Use trustworthy target identity/ownership/liveness rather than PID existence alone and never clear user pause/cancel/revocation during recovery.
runtime_tests: Use process-backed bounded fixtures for detach/reconnect continuity, agent/backend restart with child alive/dead/unknown, no duplicate launch/replay, model error/recheck, takeover preservation, boot-marker confirmation, and full shutdown survivor reporting.
Exercise PTY/pipe draining and cleanup; all spawned processes must be accounted for and terminated by test teardown.
Cover all P-C-AC-15/16/17/18/22/23 at runtime level and run predecessor regressions in proportion to changed seams.
constraints: One mutation owner. Preserve predecessor public contracts and do not edit their packages, docs, PLAN, state, workflow ledger or approval.

Prefer a small coordinator over duplicating policy logic; inject ports/adapters and keep Linux-specific process evidence isolated. No tmux dependency, real reboot, live external OMP mutation, Docker, delegation, commit, publish or deploy.
Use apply_patch and run graphify update after code changes.
report: Return candidate_ready/needs_reroute, architecture/public API and dependency wiring, runtime evidence for each acceptance ID, exact suites/counts and residue check, changed paths/hashes, unsupported/pending cases and CW-16 obligations.
